{{Top|leg}}
The '''compound bow''' was a [[Bow/Legends|bow]] utilized by the professional guards on the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Tyed Kant]]. Their [[Overseer/Legends|overseer]], [[Xun Garret]] did not allow the guards to use [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] as their long distance weapon of choice so instead the guards used the compound bow.<ref name="Mynock">{{WEGCite|story=The Mynock Conspiracy|book=Supernova (sourcebook)}}</ref>
